instruction.name: fcvt.d.ld
instruction.description: Convert an x87 80-bit extended value split across fj and fk to a double.

operands.name: fj
operands.description: upper 16 bits of the extended value

operands.name: fk
operands.description: lower 64 bits of the extended value

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: fk -> fd chain: fk is tied to fd.

latencies.notes: fk -> fd chain: fk is tied to fd.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fcvt.d.ld $f0, $f8, $f16; fcvt.d.ld $f1, $f9, $f17; fcvt.d.ld $f2, $f10, $f18; fcvt.d.ld $f3, $f11, $f19; fcvt.d.ld $f4, $f12, $f20; fcvt.d.ld $f5, $f13, $f21; fcvt.d.ld $f6, $f14, $f22; fcvt.d.ld $f7, $f15, $f23
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f16, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f17, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f18, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f19, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f20, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f21, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f22, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f23, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f16, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f17, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f18, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f19, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f20, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f21, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f22, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f23, $r4' --asm 'fcvt.d.ld $f0, $f8, $f16; fcvt.d.ld $f1, $f9, $f17; fcvt.d.ld $f2, $f10, $f18; fcvt.d.ld $f3, $f11, $f19; fcvt.d.ld $f4, $f12, $f20; fcvt.d.ld $f5, $f13, $f21; fcvt.d.ld $f6, $f14, $f22; fcvt.d.ld $f7, $f15, $f23'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 2.00 cycles, i.e. 0.25 CPI. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000); larger unroll factors inflated the value through L1I pressure.
